# authwise_issuer_domain_binding (Data Source)

Where an issuer answers: one of the tenant's domains at a path, so the issuer's URL (`iss`) is `https://<hostname><path>`. An issuer may have no binding, one, or several, each its own `iss`; one domain serves several issuers at different paths. There is no update: changing `domain_id` or `path` replaces the binding. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `domain_id` (String)
- `hostname` (String)
- `issuer_domain_binding_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `path` (String)
- `routable` (Boolean)
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `url` (String)
